d:
So many of us are living in a constant state of alarm. With racing thoughts and the feeling of always running behind. And because everyone around us feels the same, we start to believe this is just what life is.
But the nervous system is not made to stay on alert all day. It was made to meet a challenge, respond & then return home.
When that return never comes, the body keeps bracing for something that isn't there. Sleep gets lighter, patience gets thinner, joy gets harder to reach.
